parameters.content:
## AGENT TEAM ARCHITECTURE

This is NOT an automation — it's a team of 4 AI agents that
think, decide, and collaborate autonomously.

1. RESEARCH ANALYST (GPT-4o-mini) — Deep research: Amazon reviews,
   Reddit, competitor ads, TikTok + Instagram + Meta Ad Library. 8 tools.
2. CREATIVE STRATEGIST (GPT-4o) — Develops 1.5x concepts with
   TikTok reference videos, virality scoring, A/B test pairing.
3. SCRIPT WRITER (GPT-4o) — Writes full scripts for ALL concepts,
   adapting viral TikTok formats to the client's brand.
4. QA & COMPLIANCE (GPT-4o-mini) — Reviews, scores, APPROVE or REVISE.

CONCEPT OVERDELIVERY: Client orders 6 scripts → we present 9 concepts
each with a reference video/ad (TikTok, IG, FB Ad Library). Client picks.

Cost-optimized: Research & QA on GPT-4o-mini (~60% cheaper).
Creative work (Strategy + Writing) stays on GPT-4o for quality.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { body: { client_code: 'TES-0213' } } }];

parameters.content:
## 2. FETCH BRIEF
Looks up the client in Google Sheets.
All 23+ onboarding fields become agent context.

## 🔧 LLM Config
Selects Gemini or Claude based on webhook `llm_provider` param

## 🔍 Research Agent
Gathers data via SerpAPI, then synthesizes with LLM.
Replaces LangChain agent + 8 tool nodes.

## 🎯 Strategy Agent
Builds creative concepts from research.
Direct LLM call (no LangChain).

## ✍️ Writer Agent
Writes full UGC scripts from strategy.
Revision loop feeds back from QA.

## ✅ QA Agent
Reviews scripts for quality + compliance + AI detection.
Inline compliance check + authenticity scoring.

## 🔄 QA Loop
If NEEDS_REVISION (max 2), loops back to Writer.

## 5. FORMAT & OUTPUT
After QA approval, scripts are formatted
and distributed to Google Docs, ClickUp, and Slack.
